external_primary_evidence.finding: forked processes inherit descriptors referring to the same open file descriptions; flock locks are associated with open file descriptions, so inherited/duplicated descriptor possession alone cannot be treated as unique execution authority.

registered Python callbacks are not guaranteed for third-party C code that calls fork directly without CPython fork hooks, motivating an explicit process-incarnation falsifier independent of at-fork cleanup.
PyDLL keeps the GIL while calling the foreign function, avoiding CDLL GIL-release as an extra variable in the raw libc fork discriminator.
